name: Katie Osediacz Hoagland
body: I have a few good memories of Paul. First when I moved back from Chicago, Andrew and Paul came to the house where I was living in Exeter and I made us dinner and we swam in the pond. Paul was just easy to be around and kind and full of smiles. After Andrew's father's funeral, he asked me why I moved back from Chicago (aka why did I break up with my boyfriend). A mutual friend said "Dude you're not supposed to ask that" but I thought it was nice to have someone not glaze over the hard stuff -- like he asked what was on his mind with no malice and I was happy to talk about it. He made me feel seen, while I'm experiencing heartache, someone here knows and cares too.
